meta.name: Care Ledger
meta.description: A human-authored clinical field-journal identity for Reeja Maharjan's nursing and maternal-health research portfolio. It uses paper, ink, rules, chronology, evidence indexes, and one restrained red thread of care instead of generic portfolio cards and startup effects.
source_references: Reeja Maharjan professional facts and profile content
Existing portrait and approved portfolio routes
UI/UX Pro Max editorial-grid and accessibility guidance
GSAP Web Animation lifecycle and reduced-motion guidance
Three.js Guide performance, geometry, shader, and cleanup guidance

primary.role: Ink for primary text, rules, major fills, and high-contrast navigation states

secondary.role: Sage for care-oriented supporting details, list markers, and calm secondary emphasis

accent.role: Oxblood for the red thread of care, section notation, active links, and correspondence emphasis

neutral.usage: Warm paper surfaces progress to charcoal ink. Neutral contrast, borders, and spacing carry most hierarchy.

color.contrast_strategy: Dark-on-light dominant with near-black ink on warm paper, white-on-oxblood reserved for correspondence, and no low-contrast decorative text

font_families.heading: Source Serif 4, Georgia, Cambria, Times New Roman, serif
font_families.body: Public Sans, Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Editorial serif headlines provide authored character; a neutral public-service sans handles body copy; mono marginalia makes dates, folios, verification notes, and section indexes feel documented rather than decorated.

spacing.section_rhythm: Large paper-like pauses between chapters, compact evidence rows within each chapter, and consistent rule-led section openings

layout.grid_system: Asymmetric twelve-column editorial grid with a narrow folio or marginalia column
layout.columns: 12 desktop, 6 tablet, 1 to 2 mobile depending on evidence structure

border_radius.pill: 999px only for true status dots or tags

shape.border_usage: Frequent precise 1px ink and warm-neutral rules; borders establish hierarchy instead of shadows
shape.divider_style: Full-width ledger rules, occasional oxblood margin lines, and numbered folio separators

elevation.shadow_style: none for normal content; one deep shadow for the modal navigation sheet
elevation.depth_cues: Paper color changes, border hierarchy, overlapping portrait/thread composition, and modal occlusion

iconography.preferred_set: Inline SVG or CSS geometry; no emoji and no decorative medical icon set

motion.easing: Enter: cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1) / GSAP power3.out; Exit: cubic-bezier(0.3,0,1,1) / GSAP power2.in
motion.entrance_pattern: Rules establish the frame, title lines rise from clipped bounds, portrait reveals vertically, then evidence entries file into place
motion.exit_pattern: Short opacity or translation reversal without bounce
motion.philosophy: Quiet precision. Motion explains filing, revealing, indexing, and tracing rather than making every element perform.

components.button_style: Rectangular ink or paper controls with one-pixel borders and fast color inversion; no pills or lift shadows
components.input_style: Open paper fields with a strong bottom rule, visible labels, and oxblood focus indication
components.card_style: Cards are replaced by bordered evidence rows, case files, registry entries, and reading indexes
components.navigation_pattern: Numbered editorial index on desktop and a full-height paper contents sheet on mobile
components.modal_style: Paper sheet over an ink scrim with exact dialog semantics, focus trapping, inert background, and Escape support
components.list_style: Chronological ledger rows, ruled evidence lists, and mono folio numbers
components.component_notes: Every component must communicate a documented professional fact, reading path, or action. Decorative containers without information architecture are prohibited.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A nurse-researcher's field journal and evidence ledger
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary editorial design informed by archival case files, public-health reports, and print journals

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous chapter spacing with denser evidence rows
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Heavy serif mastheads balanced by light rules, narrow marginalia, and one portrait
visual_language.focal_strategy: Progressive reveal from professional identity to documented evidence to correspondence
visual_language.texture_usage: Warm paper color, photographic desaturation, ruled structures, and no synthetic noise overlays

composition.hierarchy_method: Typographic scale, spatial isolation, ruled chronology, and numbered indexing
composition.flow_direction: Top-to-bottom chapter sequence with left-margin folios and rightward evidence reading
composition.grouping_strategy: Rules and chronology rather than floating containers
composition.negative_space_role: Creates pauses between professional chapters and gives evidence the visual dignity of a report

imagery.photo_treatment: Natural portrait with reduced saturation, mild contrast, warm documentary tone, and a precise crop
imagery.illustration_style: No stock illustrations; one abstract Three.js thread based on the care continuum
imagery.graphic_elements: Oxblood margin line, folio numbers, ruled evidence tables, registration marks, and the red thread
imagery.image_shape: Rectangular documented figure with a caption and corner registration marks

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate ink inversion, underline emphasis, and visible focus rings
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: No movement or bounce; text and background invert or accent color strengthens
interaction_feel.loading_style: Content-first static rendering; advanced effects progressively enhance after content is usable

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Direct invitation using concrete actions such as Read the CV or Discuss an opportunity
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Plain explanation with useful routes and no jokes in clinical contexts

overview.fallback_strategy: Static SVG thread on low-end devices or missing WebGL2; final static composition for reduced motion

background_effects.description: No animated gradients, mesh fields, glow clouds, or decorative background video

particle_systems.description: Particles and connected-node networks are explicitly prohibited

3d_elements.description: A single oxblood thread traces a care-and-research path behind the portrait, with four brass milestone markers

params.renderer: WebGLRenderer with transparent canvas, WebGL2 requirement, DPR capped at 1.5
params.lighting: Unlit shader and basic materials; no lighting rig
params.camera: PerspectiveCamera, 34 degree field of view, fixed editorial framing
materials: Custom transparent ShaderMaterial for the thread
params.interaction_model: Very small pointer-driven rotation on fine pointers only; no orbit, drag, zoom, or scroll-jacking

shader_effects.description: The thread is progressively revealed along its UV length, like a line being traced through the record

params.fragment_output: Oxblood line with a soft leading edge, tone mapping, and output color-space conversion

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: Element top at 86 to 88 percent of the viewport
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: Short rise-and-resolve plus grouped filing stagger

scroll_morphing.description: No scroll-driven shape morphing or pinned sections

text_effects.description: Only the hero title is split by authored lines and revealed from clipped bounds

cursor_effects.description: The native cursor is preserved for familiarity and accessibility

image_effects.description: The hero portrait opens once like a documented figure being uncovered; it then remains stable

canvas_drawings.description: The canvas renders the Three.js red thread only; it is not a decorative full-screen generative background

params.draw_method: Tube mesh sampled from a centripetal Catmull-Rom curve
params.animation_loop: No permanent loop; render on reveal, resize, visibility changes, and fine-pointer interaction
params.responsiveness: ResizeObserver with camera aspect updates and mobile scale adjustment
params.interaction: Subtle pointer response on fine pointers

svg_animations.description: The SVG is a static accessibility and performance fallback for the red thread

visual_effects.composite_notes: Effects are deliberately subordinate to content. GSAP establishes hierarchy and files evidence into view; Three.js contributes one memorable signature behind the portrait. There is no continuous parallax, particle field, glow system, custom cursor, glass layer, or decorative motion. Reduced-motion users receive the complete final state immediately, and low-end or non-WebGL2 devices receive a static SVG thread.
